utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday the sixteenth. Can you hear me all right? Teams is showing about three different microphones.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, unfortunately. More reliable than the broken coffee machine in the canteen, anyway. That's just a moan, not a maintenance request.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: You've been saying that since six, Callum. We're all very aware.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: There's a birthday cake in the office, though. Doesn't replace coffee, but it's something.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, excellent nutritional briefing. What's already closed out first?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I signed off the inspection on the line 2 on Tuesday. That's finished, not another inspection for today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, closed. That's the one I could see in the history.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And I tested the site water yesterday and it's all fine now. Results are done, nothing outstanding on that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. That was the old entry I was looking at, then.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Same sort of thing here: signed off the inspection on the Air Compressor 1 on Tuesday. All completed.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay, those are completed inspections. Not dragging them back onto today's list.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, just an observation from me. Heard a slight rattle from the big boiler, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, observation only, no job coming out of that this morning.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. Just didn't want someone thinking I'd reported a fault needing work.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: On the blocked stuff, still waiting on parts for the GT1 Compressor Section, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, that stays blocked. No work to allocate against it today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Correct. It's sitting there for visibility, not as a fresh request.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the Cooling Tower. That delivery item is still blocked as well.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's the delivery entry, yeah. Separate from the replacement-parts collection we're talking about.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll go to Kestrel Hydraulics Leeds to pick up the replacement parts for the cooling tower by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: The coming Thursday, just so we're not reading yesterday's date into it?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, coming Thursday. I'll do that collection by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Thanks, Callum. Collection agreed; the separate supplier delivery is still unconfirmed.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'll check the guarding on the line 2 robot today. Normal priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—this isn't reopening the inspection I signed off?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, separate guarding check. I'll do that today, normal priority. Your completed inspection stays completed.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Clear enough. Priya has the guarding on the line 2 robot.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll inspect the water booster for leaks tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Tomorrow being Saturday? Sorry, my days have gone a bit sideways.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, Saturday. Tomorrow at 9:30, that's what I mean.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay, Sarah, agreed. The water booster inspection is tomorrow, not today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: For mine, I'll book a contractor to look at the line 2 interlock by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Where's that sitting urgency-wise? Same sort of level as the guarding check?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: More the 'if you've got a spare minute' one. I'll fit the booking in on that basis, but still by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Dave, that's the booking due by the coming Thursday, not saying the contractor will be here by then?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll have booked them by Thursday. We're not agreeing an attendance date here.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Jamie, can you swap the filter on the dryer this morning? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Can't take that, sorry. I haven't got the capacity this morning. Don't put my name against it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Fair enough. Sarah Okafor, can you take it instead—swap the filter on the dryer this morning, low priority?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that off Jamie. I'll swap the filter on the dryer this morning.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Thanks. And it is low priority, yeah? Not suddenly a production emergency?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Still low priority. This morning is the timing, but we're not calling it urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Low priority, this morning. That's with me now.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: There's also the shift handover report. It needs sending round by end of day, but I haven't got an owner against it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, somebody needs to send the shift handover report round by end of day. Anyone able to take that?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Not me, sorry. Can't commit to sending it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I can't take the report either. Don't assume it's mine because it's handover.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay. No taker, then. It still needs doing by end of day, but it's unallocated.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The other open one is to take vibration readings on the AC1 at half two. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: At half two specifically, rather than just sometime before then?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, at half two. I'm flagging the requirement, not volunteering for it—I can't take those readings.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I can't commit to that slot either, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's unallocated as well, then. AC1 vibration readings at half two: not an emergency but don't let it slip. We haven't actually got anyone taking it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So two open ownership gaps: the report and those readings. The other bits have actual commitments.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yes. And the blocked parts and delivery stay blocked. None of the completed inspections are new jobs.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: All clear on mine. Kestrel Hydraulics Leeds, replacement parts for the cooling tower, by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Good. Back to the important observation: that cake's got proper icing, not the sad thin stuff.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Your technical reports are getting very specialised.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, we'll leave it there. Just to be clear, silence hasn't assigned either of those open items to anybody. Cheers, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. And yes, we heard you about the coffee.
